original: pūrvasmin prakaraṇe krītvānuśaye parivṛttyanuśaye ca krītaviṣayaḥ parivṛtteś ca atikrama uktaḥ | atra tu samayānapākarmākhye vivādapade samayasya atikrama ucyata iti saṃgatiḥ | pūrvasmin prakaraṇe samayānapākarmākhye vivādapade naigamādiviṣayatayā saṃvidvyatikrama iti saṃgatiḥ | yady apy anayor aikādhikaraṇyam eva yuktam, tathāpi strīpuṃsākhyavivādapadopayogitayā gṛhakṣetrādinirṇayopayogitayā pṛthagadhikaraṇateti dhyeyam | pūrvasmin prakaraṇe kṣetravivādo nirnītaḥ | kṣetraṃ dvividham | sthāvarakṣetraviṣayavivādaviṣayānantaraṃ jaṅgamātmakastrīrūpakṣetrajavivādanirṇaya iti saṃgatiḥ | pūrvasmin prakaraṇe strīpuṃsākhyo dharmaḥ pratipāditaḥ | atra tu dāyavibhāgākhye vivādapade strīpuṃsāv evādhikṛtya vivādaḥ pravartata iti tayor upajīvyopajīvakatayā saṃgatiḥ | atha sāhasākhyasya padasya saṃgatiḥ | pūrvatra trayodaśavivādapadeṣu deyādeyavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ, yathāha viṣṇuḥ: “vyavahāro dvirutthānaḥ” iti | vyavahārakāraṇadvayaṃ kathitam | tathā ca gautamasūtra: “dvirutthānato dvigatiḥ” iti, vyavahāra ity anuṣajyate | tatra nibandhanakāreṇoktam – ṛṇādānādidāyavibhāgāntānāṃ deyanibandhanasāhasādipañcakasya daṇḍanibandhanatvam iti dvirutthānatety artha iti | [52] yady api manvādibhiḥ |

original: parahaste dattam upanidhikam iti dvitīyaṃ vivādapadam | etad eva saṃkhyātaṃ cen nikṣepa ity ato na bhinnaṃ vivādapadam | dāyādebhyaḥ bhayāt rājacorabhayāc ca sthāpyate ‘nyagṛhe dravyaṃ nyāsa iti na pṛthagvivādapadam | vaṇijo vāṇijyaṃ ṛtvijo yajñaṃ kṛṣīvalāḥ kṛṣiṃ hemakārādayaḥ śilpinaḥ śilpaṃ nartakādayo nṛtyādikaṃ stenāḥ steyaṃ yatra saṃhatya kurvate tat saṃbhūya kriyamāṇaṃ [55] vāṇijyādikarma samuttiṣṭhate ‘neneti vyutpattyā saṃbhūyasamutthānākhyaṃ vyavahārapadam | yatra svarṇakārādibhyaḥ prītyādinā dattaṃ dravyaṃ vaiguṇyādinā tebhyaḥ punar apahāryaṃ dattasyāpradānam asmin vidyata iti dattāpradānikaṃ nāma vivādapadam | karmakārādyavaiguṇyād dattasyānapākarma — anapanayanam asminn iti dattānapākarmāpi vivādapadam ity ato na pṛthag abhihitam | ataś ca deyam adeyaṃ dattam adattam iti dravyabhedena cāturvidhyam aviruddham | deyam aniṣiddhadānakriyānirvartakam | dattaṃ dāne sati saṃpradānād anapahāryam | dattaṃ cāpahāryam iti yac chiṣyādeḥ śuśrūṣādikam  aṅgīkṛtya gurvādyājñākaratvādyakaraṇaṃ tad abhyupetyāśuśrūṣākhyaṃ vivādapadam | śiṣyaśabdo ‘ntevāsibhṛtakakarmakṛddāsānām upalakṣaka iti tanmūle na pṛthag bhidyata ity ekam eva padam | īdṛśasya deyam īdṛśasyādeyaṃ dattam asya evaṃvidhāt pratyādeyaṃ kvacid dviguṇam ādeyam ityādy uktam | yatra vivāde tad vetanasya bhṛter anapākarma — anapanayanaṃ vidyate tad vetanānapākarmākhyaṃ vivādapadam | svāmino ‘samakṣaṃ yācitānvāhitanyāsādikaṃ paradravyaṃ vikrīyate asāv asvāmivikrayaḥ | so ‘smin vyavahāre nirṇeya ity asvāmivikrayākhyaṃ vivādapadam | mūlyena vikrayapaṇyaṃ kretur yan na pradīyate tad vikrīyāsaṃpradānam |

original: maivam, yadi dhanārjananayaḥ [165] svatvāpāyahetumānasikakriyaiveti syāt tadāyaṃ doṣaḥ prāduṣyāt, na ca tathā, svatvāpāyahetuḥ kvacit saṃkalpaḥ kvacin mahāpātakādir ity uktam | ataś ca tasyāpy adhikaraṇasya laukikavyavahārānurodhitayā svatvasyāpi laukikatvāc ca | yathā loke dṛṣṭaṃ tathā svīkartavyam | kuttādivyavahāre mānasikī kriyaiva svatvahetur iti saṃmataṃ laukikānām | tathā ca dṛśyate – bahuśo bahavaḥ kāyasthāḥ kṣetrādikaṃ deśagrāmādikaṃ vā kuttākāreṇa gṛhṇantaḥ pākṣikāpacayabhārasahiṣṇavo dṛśyante | tatra grāmādikṣetrādideśādyupacitapāribhāṣikadravye teṣāṃ vyavahārāṇāṃ svāmyaṃ vidyata eva | sa cāgamaḥ sādhīyān eva |

original: tathā ca viṣṇuḥ: “pādamātropacaye kauttikasya svāmyam” iti | atra bhāruciḥ: “so ‘yam upacayaḥ kuttātaḥ pādamātraṃ cet tasminn evopacaye uttamo manasā imam upacayaṃ kauttiko gṛhṇīta, anyadāyanāśayoḥ svāmyadhīnatvaṃ na tu kauttikasya | pādādhikaya eva svāmyāt tasyti smarati | tadā tasmin pādamātropacitadravye uttamasya svatvanivṛttiḥ parasvatvāpattiparyantā bhavatīti tātparyam” iti |
analyzed: tathā ca viṣṇuḥ pāda mātra upacaye kauttikasya svāmyam iti atra bhāruciḥ saḥ yam upacayaḥ kuttātaḥ pāda mātram ced tasmin eva upacaye uttamaḥ manasā imam upacayam kauttikaḥ gṛhṇīta anyadā aya nāśayoḥ svāmi adhīna tvam na tu kauttikasya pāda adhikayaḥ eva svāmyāt smarati tadā tasmin pāda mātra upacita dravye uttamasya sva tva nivṛttiḥ para sva tva āpatti paryantā bhavati iti tātparyam iti

original: ayam āśayaḥ – mānasikam api dānaṃ tyāgātmakaṃ svatvāpādakam iti vaiṣṇavaṃ matam iti | uttamo manasāyaṃ kauttika imam upacayaṃ gṛhṇātv iti vadatā bhārucinā yāvaty upacaye dravye uttamasya mānasikatyāgaḥ tāvaty api svatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pādam iti matam, tato nyūnena na bhavitavyam iti |
analyzed: ayam āśayaḥ mānasikam api dānam tyāga ātmakam svatva āpādakam iti vaiṣṇavam matam iti uttamaḥ manasā ayam kauttikaḥ imam upacayam gṛhṇātu iti vadatā bhārucinā yāvati upacaye dravye uttamasya mānasika tyāgaḥ tāvati api svatvam vaiṣṇavam pādam iti matam tatas nyūnena na bhavitavyam iti

original: atra kecid āhuḥ – anenaiva nyāyena kuttāyāḥ apacaye vidyamāne ‘pi pādamātram uttamena soḍhavyam | tato nyūnaṃ dūrata eva, tatrādhikam aicchikam iti viṣṇuvacanasya tātparyārtha iti |

original: tathā ca madyapasya mukhāsvādaṃ kṛtvā ekarātram upavāsaḥ | matyā pañcagavyam iti | adeyadāne kṛcchratrayam iti | gautamas tv adeyadāna sāntapanam ity āha | kalañjabhakṣaṇe pātityaṃ sarvasmṛtisiddham | adeyeṣu madhye putrakalatrādīnām adeyatvāt taddāne prāyaścittam uktam | ataś ca adeyadravyadānaṃ niṣidhyate | atra kecid āhuḥ: adeyadravyadānaniṣedhaḥ sahetuka eva | na tu nirhetukaḥ | tathā hi – sāmānyadravyam itarānujñāṃ vinā na deyam | tadanujñā ced deyam eva | putradārādidravyasya tu dāne kṛte ‘pi svatvasyānapāyāt | svatvaṃ mānasikā kriyā sakalparūpatayā nāpaiti | kiṃ tu mahāpātakādinā tadgataṃ svatvam apaitīti dhanārjananayasiddham | at evāha viṣṇuḥ: “putradārādidātā patito bhavati” iti dātṛśabdo vikretur apy upalakṣakaḥ | tathā ca gautamaḥ: “anāpadi putradārādidāne ṣaḍvārṣikaṃ caret” | tat tu durbhikṣakālaviṣayam [279] | samantarakālam āha: “dvādaśavārṣikaṃ caret” | yat tu vasiṣṭhenoktam – “āpadi putraṃ mātāpitarau dadyātāṃ hareyātām” ity uktvā “putraṃ pratigrahīṣyan bandhūn āhūya rājani nivedya svaniveśanasya madhye adūrabāndhavam asaṃnikṛṣṭaṃ vyāhṛtībhir hutvā pratigṛhṇīyāt” (VaDh 15.6) iti | āpacchabdārtham āha sa eva: “putrābhāva eva vāpad” iti | vāśabdena samuccayārthena durbhikṣakāle ‘tyantauṭumbabharaṇāśaktiḥ samuccīyate | tathā cāpadīti viśeṣaṇaṃ pratigrahītur dātur api samānam | ato vaidikatvād asya dānasa pūrvoktaṃ na viruddham | nyāsas tu mūlasvāminā anujñāto dātvaya eva | anyasya pratiśrutam api tadanujñayā deyam eva | yācitam api tathaiva | etac ca sarvasaṃmatam |

original: stryavayavānāṃ duhitṛṣu bāhulyāt strīdhanaṃ duhitṛgāmi | [363] pitṛdhanaṃ putragāmi, pitravayavānāṃ putreṣu bāhulyād iti | atra gautamena viśeṣo darśitaḥ: “strīdhanaṃ dhuhitṝṇām aprattānām apratiṣṭhitānāṃ ca” iti | asyārthaḥ – prattāprattāsamavāye aprattānām eva strīdhanam, prattāsu ca pratiṣṭhitāpratiṣṭhitāsamavāye apratiṣṭhitānām eveti | aprattā – anūḍhāḥ, apratiṣṭhitā – nirdhanāḥ | duhitrabhāve mātṛdhane ṛṇāvaśiṣṭaṃ ko gṛhṇīyād ity ata āha “tābhya ṛte ‘nvayaḥ” iti | tābhyaḥ – duhitṛbhyo vinā duhitṝṇām abhāve anvayaḥ – putrādiḥ gṛhṇīyāt | etac ca pitror ūrdhvaṃ vibhajerann ity anenaiva siddhaṃ spaṣṭārtham uktam iti vijñānayogī | etac ca “mātur duhitaraḥ śeṣam” iti vacanam anyathā vyākurvanti bhāruciprabhṛtayaḥ: putrābhāve mātṛdhanaṃ duhitaro vibhajetan | tadabhāve svānvayaḥ pitṛvyādiḥ gṛhṇīyāt, “dāyādā ūrdhvam āpnuyuḥ” iti smṛteḥ | ūrdhvam – dhanasvāminaḥ putrikāder abhāva ity arthaḥ | dāyādāḥ – dhanasvāmiputrikāpitṛvyādayaḥ | ata evoktaṃ saṃgrahakāreṇa |

original: asyārthaḥ – anaṃśau klībapatitāv iti dvitvoktyā dāyārhabhrātṛbhiḥ rikthagrāhair vā yoṣidgrāhair vā poṣyau, jātyandhabadhirāv iti dvitvoktyā tayor aṃśo ‘sty eva, kiṃ tv aṃśayuktāv api poṣyau vivāhasaṃskārasadbhāvāt | tathāśabdaprayogeṇa paṅgvādayaḥ vivāhasaṃskārārhāś ced aṃśaharāḥ poṣyāś ceti rahasyam | unmattajaḍamūkāś ceti samuccayoktyā te ‘pi bhartavyā eva nāṃśaharāḥ | vivāhārhā na ced iti śeṣaḥ | “ye ca kecin nirindriyāḥ” iti strīṇām apy upalakṣaṇaṃ nirindriyāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ sapatnīduhitṛbhaginīprabhṛtīnāṃ puṃsāṃ ca bhrātṛtatsutabhrātṛvyādīnāṃ mātulādīnāṃ ca saṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryam iti | kecit tu nirindriyāḥ vyādhinā vinaṣṭaghrāṇādīndriyā ity āhuḥ | yat tu nāradenoktam,
analyzed: asya arthaḥ anaṃśau klība patitau iti dvi tva uktyā dāya arha bhrātṛbhiḥ rikthagrāhaiḥ vā yoṣidgrāhaiḥ vā poṣyau jātyandha badhirau iti dvi tva uktyā tayoḥ aṃśaḥ u sti eva kim tu aṃśa yuktau api poṣyau vivāha saṃskāra sadbhāvāt tathāśabda prayogeṇa paṅgu ādayaḥ vivāha saṃskāra arhāḥ ced aṃśa harāḥ poṣyāḥ ca iti rahasyam unmatta jaḍa mūkāḥ ca iti samuccaya uktyā te bhartavyāḥ eva na aṃśa harāḥ vivāha arhāḥ na ced iti

original: mṛte pitari klībādayo dāyāṃśino na bhavantīty arthaḥ | liṅgī naiṣthikavanasthādiḥ kṣapaṇakapāśupatādiś ca | patitāpatyam iti pātityadaśāyām utpannaḥ putraḥ | tatpūrvotpannasya putrasya pitṛgatapātityadoṣānuṣaṅgābhāvāt | pitāputrasaṃbandho laukikaḥ pātityādau nivartata iti purastān nivedayiṣyate | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ: “teṣām evaurasāḥ putrāḥ bhāgahāriṇo na tu patitasya patanīye kṛte karmaṇy anantarotpannāḥ | pratilomāsu strīṣūtpannāś cābhāginaḥ tatpurāḥ paitāmahe 'py arthe" iti | mṛte pitarīty atrāpiśabdo ‘dhyāhārārthaḥ, pitari mṛte ‘py amṛte ‘pīti klībādayo nāṃśaharā iti vyākhyeyam | tathā ca āpastambaḥ: “jīvan putrebhyo dāyaṃ vibhajet samaṃ klībam unmattaṃ patitaṃ ca parihāpya” iti | parihāpya – varjayitvā | caśabdo vivāhānarhāṇām upalakṣakaḥ | candrikākāras tu “mṛte pitarīti vibhāgakālapradarśanārtham uktam” ity āha | tena vibhāgakāle sthite klaibyādiśālinām apy abhāgaharatvam | na punaḥ klaibyabādhiryādiśālinām eveti mantavyam iti | yat tu yājñavalkyenoktam,

original: mātṛkaṃ rikthaṃ sarve sahodarāḥ samaṃ bhajeran | sanābhayo [384] bhaginyaś ca samaṃ bhajerann iti saṃbandhaḥ | na punaḥ sahodarā bhaginyaś ca saṃbhūya samaṃ vibhajeran iti, pūrvoktakramapratipādakavacanavirodhāt, vibhāgakartṛtvānvayenāpi caśabdopapatteś ca | yathā devadattaḥ pacatu yajñadattaś ceti | samagrahaṇam uddhāranivṛttyarthaṃ | sodaragrahaṇaṃ bhinnodaranivṛttyartham | ata eva viṣṇuḥ: “bhaginīśulkaṃ mātuḥ sodarāṇām eva” iti | ayam arthaḥ – bhaginīśulkātmakaṃ strīdhanaṃ mātur eva | mātur abhāve sodarāṇām eva na bhinnodarāṇām ity arthaḥ | yat tu gautamasūtram: “bhaginīśulkaṃ sodarāṇām ūrdhvaṃ mātuḥ” iti, tat mātur ūrdhvaṃ sodarāṇām ity anvayaparam | tathāha bodhāyanaḥ: “strīdhanaṃ mātṛgāmi tadabhāve sodarabhrātṛgāmi” iti strīdhanaṃ kanyāśulkam | ataś ca “kanyāśulkaviṣayasodarāsodaravibhāge sodarāṇām api kiṃcid deyam” ity asahāyavyākhyānam asahāyam | bhaginīśūlkaṃ sodarāṇām “ūrdhvaṃ mātuḥ” ityādiṣu smṛtiṣu bhaginīśulkarūpe sarvasmin dhane sodarāṇām eva svāmyapratipādanāt | putrāṇām abhāve pautrāḥ pitāmahadhanahāriṇa iti vacobhaṅgyāha gautamaḥ: “ṛṇapradātāraś ca rikthabhājaḥ ṛṇaṃ pratikuryuḥ” iti, “putrapautraiḥ ṛṇaṃ deyam” iti pautrāṇām api pitāmahyṛṇāpākaraṇe adhikārāt |
analyzed: mātṛkam riktham sarve sahodarāḥ samam bhajeran sanābhayaḥ bhaginyaḥ ca samam bhajeran iti saṃbandhaḥ na punar sahodarāḥ bhaginyaḥ ca saṃbhūya samam vibhajeran iti pūrva ukta krama pratipādaka vacana virodhāt vibhāga kartṛ tva anvayena api caśabda upapatteḥ ca yathā devadattaḥ pacatu yajñadattaḥ ca iti sama grahaṇam uddhāra nivṛtti artham sodara grahaṇam bhinnodara nivṛtti artham atas eva viṣṇuḥ bhaginī śulkam mātuḥ sodarāṇām eva iti ayam arthaḥ

original: pāṣaṇḍanaigamaśreṇigaṇadharmaviparyayā iti | asyārthaḥ – pāṣanḍiṇāṃ dharmāḥ paṭṭaṇe asmin sthale pāṣaṇḍinaḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ naigamā api śreṇayo ‘pi gaṇā apītyādipratiniyatasthlāvasthānāni dharmāḥ teṣāṃ viparyayo na tu kuṅkumavasantāndolikādayas teṣāṃ samayānapāpakarmākhye pratipāditatvāt | teṣāṃ vivādānāṃ vādiprativādisadbhāve caturvyāpitvasadbhāvāt [498] rājaikaniyatatvābhāvāc ca | pitāputravivādaś ceti – ayam arthaḥ – yah kaścid bandikṛto vā deśāntaragato vā cirakālam api sthitvā samāgatyāsau mama pitāsau putra ityādi, pitṛputragrahaṇaṃ patnyādīnām upalakṣakam | asau mama patir iyaṃ patṇītyādi, atra sākṣiṇo na santi svayaṃ tu na jānanti divyādikaṃ nāvatarati śapathādibhḥ śodhayitum anucitam iti, ataś ca rājaikaniyatatvāt rājñaiva nirṇayaḥ kārya iti | pitāputrasaṃśaye nirṇayaprakāram āha viṣṇuḥ: “putrasaṃśaye mātā tam aṅkam āropayed vikṛtiś cen nirṇetavyaḥ’ iti | prakṛtiḥ kāmavikāraḥ | tad viṃśativarṣīyamātṛkapañcadaśvarṣīyaputraviṣayam | vṛddhamātṛviṣaye tadabhāvān nirṇayāntaram āhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau: “svapantaṃ putram āhūya jñātavyam” iti | ekenāpi prakāreṇa nirṇayābhāve abhiṣiktasya rājño hṛdayam eva pramāṇam ity āha viṣnuḥ: “atra rājño hṛdayam eva pramāṇam” iti | ata evāha kālidāsaḥ:
analyzed: pāṣaṇḍa naigama śreṇi gaṇa dharma viparyayāḥ iti asya arthaḥ pāṣanḍiṇām dharmāḥ paṭṭaṇe asmin sthale pāṣaṇḍinaḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ naigamāḥ api gaṇāḥ api ityādi pratiniyata sthlāva sthānāni dharmāḥ teṣām viparyayaḥ na tu kuṅkuma vasanta āndolikā ādayaḥ teṣām sama yāna pāpa karma ākhye pratipādita tvāt teṣām vivādānām vādi prativādi sadbhāve catur vyāpi tva sadbhāvāt rāja eka niyata tva abhāvāt ca pitāputra vivāda
